words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as a completion, not a fresh start. It joins the evil-deed condition to the good-deed condition in 99:7, so the reader hears one coordinated accounting rule with two moral poles. The attached word-shape in {{ar:وَمَن}} ({{tr:wa-man}}) makes the link inseparable from the conditional itself, while the shift from the opening particle of 99:7 to this coordinating particle marks the movement from first case to necessary counterpart.

topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) as coordination with 99:7, and the attachment evidence identifies the repeated conditional formula across 99:7-8.

words.gloss_range: universal conditional particle and human-referring whoever, governing the condition-consequence unit
words.prose: {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) supplies both the universal person-slot and the governing conditional frame. It controls the jussive doing and seeing verbs, so the ayah is not a loose maxim about evil but a condition-consequence mechanism: whoever does even the measured harmful amount will see it. Because the same conditional opening appears in 99:7, the person-slot stays unchanged when the moral quality changes; no narrower class of people is introduced for the harmful side.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that action and seeing are grammatically locked into one condition-consequence unit.
topics.reason: QAC identifies {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) as a jussive conditional particle, and attachment evidence links the protasis and apodosis under the condition.

words.prose: {{ar:يَعْمَلْ}} ({{tr:yaʿmal}}) opens the action-slot after {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}), in jussive conditional form rather than as a dated report of one past act. The verb then takes {{ar:مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا}} ({{tr:mithqāla dharratin sharran}}) as a measured object-field, so the wording does not simply say that someone does evil; it says that performed action enters reckoning at a calibrated minimal amount. The root's work-and-production range makes the deed an authored output, while local Form I keeps the responsibility direct and does not turn the clause into delegation or transaction. That same broad action verb, often associated with faith and righteous deeds in the wider distribution, can carry harmful production here because the specification changes. Across 99:6-8, the same action root moves from collective deeds to an individual doing, and the identical doing-measure construction of 99:7-8 handles good and evil by the same grammar. Paired with {{ar:يَرَهُۥ}} ({{tr:yarahu}}), it makes what one does become what one sees.

topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:يَعْمَلْ}} ({{tr:yaʿmal}}) as an imperfect jussive Form I verb governed by the conditional particle.

words.prose: {{ar:مِثْقَالَ}} ({{tr:mithqāla}}) turns the deed into something weighed. As a construct head before {{ar:ذَرَّةٍ}} ({{tr:dharratin}}), it does not name vague heaviness but fixes the scale as the weight of a speck. Its accusative role after {{ar:يَعْمَلْ}} ({{tr:yaʿmal}}) makes the measured amount part of what is done, and the form points to calibrated weighing rather than mere moral notice. The phrase belongs to a recognized smallest-weight reckoning formula (21:47, 10:61, 34:3, 4:40), here specialized for the harmful pole. The root also recalls the surah's earlier heavy contents in 99:2, so the close compresses cosmic burden-language into the smallest individual accountable unit, with the denser measuring word heard before the lighter speck unit.

words.prose: {{ar:ذَرَّةٍۢ}} ({{tr:dharratin}}) supplies the scale for the measure. Its genitive role makes it dependent on {{ar:مِثْقَالَ}} ({{tr:mithqāla}}), so it is the unit of weight rather than a second deed or an independent object. The indefinite ending keeps the threshold open to any speck-sized amount, and the concrete range of tiny ant, dust-mote, atom, or smallest knowable particle keeps the minimum vivid without forcing one era-bound referent. A possible dispersal etymology remains only a secondary pressure behind the particle image; the local syntax still selects the speck as the measurement unit. Repeated from 99:7, it fixes the same lowest measurement floor for both good and evil.

words.prose: {{ar:شَرًّا}} ({{tr:sharran}}) is the moral specification of the measured amount. It stands accusative after the completed measure phrase, so the grammar says a speck-weight specifically of harm or evil, not an evil speck as a separate unit. Its indefinite form leaves the slot open to any harmful instance at that scale. In the 99:7-8 pair, this is the controlled replacement for the good specification: the measure, condition, and seeing verb stay stable while the moral polarity changes. The root range keeps harm concrete enough to include damage and worsening, and the spark branch can sharpen the image of tiny harm without turning the verse into fire imagery. Unlike human misjudgment of good and bad in 2:216, this harmful specification is fixed by the accounting frame. Its compact, rougher sound helps the polarity shift land at the boundary, and the noisy buying-selling root link is corrected away from the local derivation, which is {{ar:ش ر ر}} ({{tr:sh-r-r}}).

words.prose: {{ar:يَرَهُۥ}} ({{tr:yarahu}}) closes the condition as the inevitable apodosis: whoever performs the measured harmful deed sees it. The attached object suffix compresses the whole preceding phrase, so the final word does not restate the deed, measure, and consequence; it gathers them into one seen object. The root makes the consequence evidentiary: the deed is not merely reported or known at a distance but encountered through perception and recognition, complementing the judgment-day knowing of 82:5 with direct seeing. A passive variant exposes the contrast of being shown the deed, while the local canonical form keeps the doer grammatically active in perception; recitational lengthening or clipping of the final suffix puts sound pressure on the object at closure. Since the same verb closes 99:7 and 99:8, seeing is the invariant endpoint for both moral poles, and the shared verbal cadence binds doing to seeing. The surah ends by tightening the public display of deeds in 99:6 into individual confrontation, with the small final suffix carrying deed, measure, consequence, and closure together.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction "يعمل مثقال ذرة شرا يره" links intentional doing, a calibrated weight, the smallest particle, evil, and seeing.
baseline_models.mechanism: An intentional act enters an exact granular measure; even its least harmful unit remains perceptible to the person who did it.

activation_trace.role: Intentional doing identifies the measured item as purposive action rather than an accidental event.
Standard weight and weighing make the act subject to exact calibration.
Tiny scattered motes set the lower granularity of what still counts.
Evil and badness supply the negative value carried by the measured act.
Seeing by eye or insight makes the result an encounter rather than an abstract entry.

changed_reading.before: A very small harmful deed might be negligible or disappear into a general total.
changed_reading.after: Every intentional evil remains individually measurable and available to direct or inward perception, down to a mote.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence "ذرة شرا يره" permits the harmful object to be imagined through particle, spark, emergence, and visibility branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: Harm behaves like a minute emitted fragment: it may scatter like powder or a spark, but its smallness does not keep it latent because it is brought into the field of sight.

activation_trace.role: Intentional doing keeps the particulate image attached to a deed.
Scattering grains or powder supplies the deed's particulate dispersion.
Flying sparks give the harmful particle an emitted and potentially propagating form.
Showing or bringing out reverses any concealment of the tiny harmful fragment.
Making something seen supplies the final exposure of what was emitted.

changed_reading.before: Evil is only an abstract moral quantity that is later noticed.
changed_reading.after: Evil can be pictured as a minute spark or scattered fragment of action whose scale cannot prevent its eventual exposure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The roots in "يعمل مثقال ذرة شرا يره" also carry branches of dealing, weighing, exchange, equivalence, and residue.
baseline_models.mechanism: A harmful act enters a transaction-like relation, is matched by exact weight, and leaves even its tiniest remainder outstanding until the doer encounters it. This model deliberately uses the packet's non-dominant mappings for ش ر ي and ر و ي.

activation_trace.role: Dealing or transaction between people frames action as an accountable exchange.
Standard weighing supplies exact settlement rather than rough estimation.
The tiny mote prevents any residual amount from falling below account.
The split-root image of exchange through buying and selling supplies the transactional mechanism.
Equivalence and matching make the harmful side answerable by a commensurate counterpart.
The split-root image of a remaining residue supplies what stays outstanding after the exchange.

changed_reading.before: The verse only predicts visual awareness of a past bad act.
changed_reading.after: The tiniest harmful dealing can remain as an unsettled, exactly matched residue that returns to the actor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The shaken ground loses its containing stability and expels concealed burdens. Against that sequence, the focus act's standard weight and mote become the smallest hidden load forced outward into visibility.

activation_trace.role: Disturbance and shaking destabilize the container that had kept its contents in place.
The lower ground supplies the material substrate in which burdens had been held.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the transition from hidden content to exposed object.
The repeated lower ground now functions as the agent that releases what it contained.
Heaviness casts the expelled contents as burdens rather than neutral debris.
Standard weighing scales the macro-burden down to an exact personal measure.
The tiny mote makes even the least concealed burden eligible for expulsion.
Showing or bringing out lets the focus harm participate in the context's extraction pattern.
Making seen completes the passage from buried load to exposed evidence.

structural_cues: 99:1 repeats the shaking root as verb and cognate object around the earth.
99:2 keeps the earth as subject and moves from shaking to causative expulsion of its burdens.
99:8 compresses that macro-exposure into a singular mote-sized object followed by seeing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a shaken substrate, expulsion from concealment, burdens, exact weight, and visibility; I infer that a deed can occupy the role of an expelled burden. A live alternative is that the earth's burdens are bodies or contents and only analogically illuminate the deed.

changed_reading.before: The doer merely consults or receives an abstract moral total.
changed_reading.after: Even a mote of evil is a concealed personal load that the upheaval forces out into a visible, exactly weighed form.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human bewilderment is answered by the earth's renewed report of interior knowledge under sovereign hidden communication. The focus seeing therefore becomes reception of authorized disclosure about an intentional evil, not bare optical detection.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the human question that calls for an intelligible answer.

Intentional doing identifies the disclosed content as attributable action.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies question, report, interior knowledge, sovereign authority, hidden communication, and seeing; I assign the directional arrow from authorized report to evidence about the deed. changed_reading.before: Seeing the evil is an unmediated private perception.
changed_reading.after: Seeing the evil is receiving an authorized disclosure in which the earth's report makes the hidden act personally apprehensible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The writing-and-engraving branch of communication lets the earth function as a recording surface: intentional evil leaves a minute trace in its interior, the report reveals that trace, and seeing becomes a reading of the exposed inscription.

activation_trace.role: Bringing forth and revealing supplies the surfacing of a previously stored trace.

The materially live alternative is that the writing branch is only an image for communication and that no inscription mechanism is intended.

changed_reading.before: The evil is remembered or announced without a material carrier.
changed_reading.after: The mote of evil can be read as a minute inscription in the earth's record that emerges and is made visible to its author.

context_deltas.mechanism: People issue forth in separation to be shown intentional works. The source branch of صدور turns that dispersal into an attribution mechanism: a scattered corpus is sorted back to the human origin from which each act issued, so no mote loses its doer.

The appearing human, contrasted with the wild or hidden, identifies the accountable class of sources.
Dispersion and separation create the sorting problem that attribution resolves.

Intentional works are the objects presented after separation.

The tiny scattered mote tests whether source attribution survives maximal granularity.

structural_cues: 99:6 moves from plural people in separated groups to a passive purpose clause in which their works are shown.
99:8 narrows that plural display to an indefinite singular doer and a singular pronominal object.
The particle image in 99:8 echoes dispersion while preserving one-to-one attribution.

changed_reading.before: The doer happens to see one isolated harmful result.
changed_reading.after: A dispersed field of works is resolved back to its human sources, and even one mote of evil is presented to the exact person from whom it issued.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah repeats the focus frame while changing only the moral object from beneficial good to evil. Repeated action, weight, particle, and sight create one symmetric rule of commensuration whose positive and negative sides are separately visible.

activation_trace.role: Intentional doing begins the positive member with the same accountable action as the focus.
The repeated standard weight fixes an unchanged scale across both moral values.
The repeated tiny mote fixes an unchanged lower threshold across the pair.
Inclination toward beneficial good supplies the positive value contrasted with focus evil.
Repeated seeing gives both values the same mode of eventual encounter.
Dealing or transaction lets the paired clauses operate as two sides of one account.

structural_cues: 99:7 and 99:8 repeat the same conditional syntax, root sequence, scale, and final pronoun.
The sole lexical polarity change is from خير to شر.
The two clauses remain separate, so symmetry does not erase the moral distinction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an almost exact repeated frame with opposite value terms and branches of measuring, transaction, and matching; I infer a single symmetric accounting rule. The alternative is that the repetition is emphatic contrast without any transactional mechanism.

changed_reading.before: 99:8 is an isolated warning that magnifies tiny evil.
changed_reading.after: 99:8 is the negative half of a paired rule: beneficial and harmful acts are preserved, measured at the same minimum scale, and separately encountered.

surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus makes the doer see the singular harmful object, while the preceding display scene supplies a human image in the eye.

Visible appearance and mirror make the final seeing reflexive rather than merely observational.

changed_reading.before: The doer sees a harmful object wholly external to the self.
changed_reading.after: The encounter can be imagined as mirror-like self-recognition: the displayed deed returns the doer's own human image to sight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a non-dominant ر و ي branch about chiefs carrying communal burdens inside the focus verb of seeing. The weight, burden, dealing, and plural-human context keep it structurally anchored, but it should be rendered only as a social-liability echo and never as a claim that the focus cancels individual responsibility or transfers guilt.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The singular doer, exact weight, harmful act, and seeing remain primary while split-root branches introduce a possible social burden around that encounter.

activation_trace.role: The appearing human collective supplies the social field within which liabilities can be carried.
Dispersion and separation prevent the social field from becoming an undifferentiated collective.
Dealing between people supplies the relational origin of some harmful liabilities.

The split-root image of chiefs bearing communal burdens introduces a social carrier without displacing the focus doer.

changed_reading.before: The mote of evil is only a private object with no relational afterlife.
changed_reading.after: The individually encountered evil may also echo as an attached liability moving through a differentiated human network.

strongest_changes: The earth's shaking and expulsion turn abstract reckoning into exposure of even the smallest concealed burden.
The earth's authorized reporting turns seeing into reception of disclosed evidence about one's intentional act.
The scattered display in 99:6 sharpens the focus into source-level attribution: no particulate deed loses its doer.
The exact parallel with 99:7 makes 99:8 one negative member of a symmetric rule for good and evil.
summary.what_was_special: The context repeatedly converts scale and medium: a world-sized upheaval contracts to a mote, buried weight becomes report and sight, and plural scattered works resolve to a singular doer-object encounter. Split mappings additionally expose coherent but form-distant exchange, residue, mirror, and communal-burden models.
remaining_uncertainties: The earth's expelled burdens may be bodies or physical contents rather than deeds, leaving the exhumed-deed model analogical.
The reporting and communication sequence securely supports disclosure but only exploratorily supports a literal recording or inscription substrate.
The source-sorting model depends on extending the separation of people to the attribution of deeds.
The exchange, residue, mirror, and communal-liability readings rely on packet-licensed but non-dominant or branch-distant images and require explicit qualification.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Minimum evil as measured visible output.** Lexical evidence: `ع م ل B001` intentional doing; `ث ق ل B004` standard weight/weighing; `ذ ر ر B001` tiny particle; `ش ر ر B001` evil/badness; `ر ء ي B001/B012` seeing/showing. Structural cue: this ayah mirrors 99:7 almost exactly, replacing `خيرا` with `شرا`. Assigned role: the mirror structure prevents evil from being exempted by smallness; it receives the same measurement and display mechanism as good. Abductive move: I infer parity of accounting from syntactic parallelism. Reading change: the ayah reads as exact moral symmetry at the smallest scale.

2. **Evil as spark from a tiny unit.** Lexical evidence: `ش ر ر B003` flying sparks of fire; `ذ ر ر B001/B002` tiny scattered motes/scattering; activated by `و ح ي B008` authority/fire in 99:5 and the sudden exposure sequence. Structural cue: the small `ذرة` touches `شرا` directly before final seeing. Assigned role: evil is like a spark: small, flying, and liable to be seen despite its minuteness. Abductive move: I infer that tiny evil has energetic consequence because the branch inventory allows `شرر` as sparks while the ayah makes evil particle-sized. Reading change: the ayah warns not only that small evil is counted, but that it can flare from a tiny source.

3. **Drying/spreading exposure of evil.** Lexical evidence: `ش ر ر B002` spreading something in the sun to dry; activated by `ر ء ي B011/B012` marker/showing and `ذ ر ر B004` rising/spreading emergence. Structural cue: the final `يره` makes the evil visible after it has been measured. Assigned role: the evil is laid out like material exposed to sun: no longer damp, hidden, or folded. Abductive move: I supply the exposure-to-light mechanism from the branch image; the packet gives seeing and spread. Reading change: the ayah reads as visible desiccation of concealed wrong, not merely private recognition.

4. **Shredding loose from the self.** Lexical evidence: `ش ر ر B004` shredding/cutting/shaking loose; `ش ر ر B007` throwing one’s whole self into something; activated by `ع م ل B007` self-exertion/taking trouble and `ق و ل B006` drawing a saying to oneself. Structural cue: the person did the work; now he sees it as an object distinct enough to confront. Assigned role: evil attaches to the self by intention, then is shaken loose as visible evidence. Abductive move: I infer a reversal from invested self to separated exhibit because the packet moves from `يعمل` to `يره`. Reading change: the ayah reads as disidentification: what one threw oneself into returns as an external thing one must face.

5. **Burdens with dangling appendages.** Lexical evidence: `ش ر ر B006` trailing appendages and burdens; activated by `ث ق ل B001/B004` heaviness/weight and 99:2’s `أثقالها`. Structural cue: 99:2’s earth-burdens are mirrored at micro-scale by `مثقال ذرة شرا`. Assigned role: evil is a tiny burden that nevertheless trails after the actor. Abductive move: I infer continuity between macro earth-burdens and micro moral weight because both use the ثقل field and culminate in seeing. Reading change: the ayah reads as the return of one’s smallest trailing burden, not only the discovery of a discrete bad deed.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: As the final ayah, no later ayah remained to alter it. The surprise came internally through its backward activation of the whole surah: the last `يره` made the earlier quake, output, report, and revelation read as one apparatus for making even particle-sized evil visible.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Exact formal symmetry removes any threshold asymmetry.** Fixed `ش ر ر/B001` supplies evil as the opposite of good; fixed `ث ق ل/B004` supplies exact known weight, fixed `ذ ر ر/B001` the tiny unit, fixed `ع م ل/B001` intentional action, and fixed `ر ء ي/B001` seeing. The construction duplicates 99:7 and changes only `خَيْرًا` to `شَرًّا`. The repeated frame assigns evil the same measurement and visibility mechanism as good. No additional causal assumption is needed beyond treating formal identity as procedural identity. The ayah therefore denies a reading in which small evil escapes by a different threshold.

2. **Aggregate evil is disassembled into attributable particles.** Fixed `ش ر ر/B004` supplies shredding, splitting, and shaking loose; fixed `ذ ر ر/B002` supplies scattering powder or grains, and fixed `ث ق ل/B004` supplies measurement. The preceding `أَشْتَاتًا` (`ش ت ت/B001`) has already separated the people before this ayah separates an act down to a mote's weight. These branches assign `شَرًّا` a disaggregation role within the measuring procedure. The inference is that the disclosure process decomposes aggregate conduct into individually attributable pieces. Evil consequently cannot remain hidden inside a larger undifferentiated whole.

3. **A tiny evil can be minute in mass yet expansive in propagation.** Fixed `ش ر ر/B003` supplies flying sparks, while fixed `ذ ر ر/B002` supplies scattering fine material. The nearby dispersed people provide a social field across which a small originating unit could spread. The branches supply spark and scattering; the arrow from one small act to wider effects is inferred. This changes `مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا` from "negligible harm" into a compact source whose consequences need not share its small scale.

4. **Hidden evil is laid out for inspection.** Fixed `ش ر ر/B002` supplies spreading something in the sun to dry, and fixed `ر ء ي/B001` supplies seeing. The local sequence moves from earth-report in 99:4, through deeds being shown in 99:6, to the direct `يَرَهُ` here. The spreading branch gives evil the role of material placed on an exposed surface. The move from drying-display to evidentiary exposure is analogical and inferred. The final verb then reads as inspection of what has been laid open, not merely inward remembrance.

5. **Evil can be a trailing, weighted attachment to its actor.** Fixed `ش ر ر/B006` supplies trailing appendages and burdens, while fixed `ث ق ل/B001` supplies heaviness and fixed `ع م ل/B001` intentional action. The previous possessive `أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ` attaches deeds to their agents, and this ayah's object pronoun carries the evil through to `يَرَهُ`. The branch's role is attachment: the act trails the doer as a burden until seen. That persistence is inferred, so this reading is exploratory. It makes the measured evil something still borne by its source rather than an event severed from the actor.

findings.text: Toplu hâlde gizlenen kötülük, ölçüm sırasında kişiye bağlanabilir parçacıklara ayrıştırılır.
Küçük bir kötülük ağırlıkça önemsiz görünse de kıvılcım gibi yayılabilen sonuçlar doğurabilir.
Gizli kötülük, görülmek üzere açık bir yüzeye serilmiş madde gibi de okunabilir.
Kötülük, eylemi yapanın peşinden ayrılmayan ve görülene kadar onunla taşınan küçük bir yük niteliği kazanır.
Kişinin kendini bütünüyle verdiği kötülük, sonunda ondan ayrılıp önüne konan bir nesneye dönüşür.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same transition extends from geological release to departure routes, disclosure, sprinkled particles, and goods spread beneath the sun.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Dispersion across an Open Field
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Compact matter or a gathered population is separated into many units and spread over space.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: scattering grains or powder `ذ ر ر:B002/m01`; dispersed groups `ش ت ت:B001/m01`; goods spread for drying `ش ر ر:B002/m01`; diffused sunrise `ذ ر ر:B004/m01`

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, topluluk adına kan bedellerini ve ağır yükümlülükleri üstlenen ileri gelenleri açıkça tanımlar ve adlandırmayı yük taşıyan hayvana benzetmeyle açıklar. Dal çerçevesi kişi rolünü ve taşınan toplumsal yükü doğru korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın çoğul kişi adını korur ve benzetmeyi su taşıyan hayvanın ayrı sözlük anlamıyla birleştirmez.

concept_map.definition: Topluluk adına kan bedellerini ve başka ağır mali yükümlülükleri üstlenip taşıyan ileri gelenlerdir. Adlandırma, onların bu yükü topluluk üzerinden almasına dayanan yük taşıma benzetisiyle açıklanır.

facets.statement: Topluluğun ileri gelenlerinin kan bedeli ve ağır yükümlülükleri topluluk adına üstlenmesi temel anlamdır.
Kişilerin adlandırılması, ağır yük taşıyan hayvana benzetilerek açıklanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak içeriği, topluluğun ileri gelenlerini kan bedeli ve ağır yükümlülük taşıyıcıları olarak tanımlar; kişi adını fiziksel yük taşıma benzetisine bağlar.
